Initial release: introduces a comprehensive six-dimension evolution system for AI agents.

- Enables agents to transform from reactive assistants to proactive partners with six evolution files: lessons tracking, success patterns, decision review, preference tracking, skill statistics, and knowledge gap detection.
- Provides an activation and setup workflow with workspace file checks, user prompts, and command instructions.
- Integrates with daily and session review scheduling via HEARTBEAT.md for continuous self-improvement.
- Includes detailed documentation for use cases, file structure, and customization options.
